title: After sealing the Vale barrow doors for good (the game itself said 'go in (locked: sealed for good if you sealed them...)' confirming it's irreversible), the gray priest still offered 'break my word to the reeve: release me' on a later visit. Choosing it applied (the Watch -1), (the Gray Church +1), granted a perk called 'Quiet Resolve', made Tamsin disapprove, and flipped the already-completed 'Barrow Doors' quest to 'Failed' in status -- even though the doors remained physically sealed the whole time and the reeve had already thanked me in person for keeping my word ('Sealed, as you said. The watch won't forget that.').
where: Gray Chapel / talk to gray priest (option: break my word to the reeve)
